description: Three separate sine oscillators running at low frequency, each with its own frequency control and modulation input

params.text: Sets that oscillator's frequency, 0.0039Hz to 1024Hz, starting at 2Hz
An attenuverter for that oscillator's modulation input, -100% to +100%, starting at zero

inputs.text: A steady voltage here shifts that oscillator's frequency by an octave per volt, and a changing one modulates it; the channels patched here set that output's polyphony

outputs.text: A bipolar sine wave, plus or minus 5V
